skills.description: Core language concepts including ES6+, closures, prototype inheritance, event loop, and asynchronous programming.
Server-side JavaScript runtime environment, core modules (fs, http, path), event-driven architecture, and streams.
Fast, unopinionated minimalist web framework for Node.js, routing, middleware patterns, and error handling.
Relational query language including complex joins, aggregations, subqueries, indexing strategies, and ACID transactions.
Advanced open-source relational database, constraints, indexes (B-tree, GIN), JSONB operations, and query optimization (EXPLAIN).
HTTP semantics (methods, status codes, headers), RESTful resource design, idempotency, authentication (JWT), and request validation.
Distributed version control, branching strategies, rebase vs merge, resolve merge conflicts, and commit hygiene.
Containerization fundamentals, Dockerfile multi-stage builds, port mappings, volumes, networking, and Docker Compose.
In-memory data store for caching, session management, Pub/Sub, and TTL key expiration.
